changelog: Every item now has a Delete button right next to Edit on the Items page.
Deleting a category now deletes the items inside it too, instead of refusing. The confirmation tells you exactly how many items will go, and past orders keep their own record of what was sold.

Orders list: Status is now a dropdown — change a job's stage straight from the list without opening the order. It applies to every job in that order, and if something cannot move (for example the customer has not approved the design yet) it says so and moves the rest.
